description: This file defines an enum SegmentType representing different positional roles of segments in a UI node, including methods for coordinate calculations and resize edge detection.

classes.name: SegmentType
classes.description: An enum describing various segment positions (left, top, right, bottom, baseline, center, unknown) with methods for coordinate calculations and resize edge detection.

methods.name: isHorizontal
methods.description: Checks if the segment is horizontal (top, bottom, baseline, center horizontal).

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Calculates the X coordinate for the segment based on its type and bounds.

methods.name: getY
methods.description: Calculates the Y coordinate for the segment based on its type and bounds.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant.

methods.name: getHorizontalResizeEdge
methods.description: Determines the horizontal resize edge segment type based on a direction.

methods.name: getVerticalResizeEdge
methods.description: Determines the vertical resize edge segment type based on a direction.
